lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs. The column immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit contains 7 distinct nodes. Inter-blob distance remains relatively constant within columns, while inter-column distance increases towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the centroids of the circular blobs, forming a localized grid pattern of anchor nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal features are visible on the upper flank, defined by a high-contrast transition from a high-luminance upper edge to a low-luminance (shadowed) lower edge, indicating structural ridges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 7 high-luminance blobs of varying diameters, distributed in two sparse, vertical rows with higher density near the leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Four elongated, low-luminance objects with distinct horizontal trajectories (consistent with Echeneidae silhouettes) are visible adjacent to the ventral and posterior-lateral regions of the primary subject.
